newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Heavy up on demand for lower-priced issues.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy up on demand for lower-priced issues.

text.p: Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd rose in Wednesday morning trade as blue chips were sold and a quest for lower-priced shares continued, brokers said.
As of 0110 GMT, shares in the car manufacturer were up five yen at 605.
Trade totalled 4.073 million shares, making it the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Brokers said that higher-priced blue chips, which had rallied recently, were weakening as investors were selling such shares ahead of the end-March book closing in order to make up for shortfalls.
Instead, cheaper shares with solid earning prospects, such as Fuji Heavy, were being bought.
